fee_notes: Royalty is per-unit at closing (Point of Closing Royalty): 2% for units 1-6, 1.75% for 7-12, 1.50% for 13-24, 1.25% for 25-50, 1% for 51+; minimum $3,000 per unit. Minimum Monthly Royalty of $2,000/month (waived if a unit closed in prior month). Marketing Program Fee is $625/month per project (not a % of gross sales). Tech royalty of $1,500/unit if Technology Royalty Addendum signed.
raw_excerpt: Minimum Monthly Royalty $2,000 per month... Point of Closing Royalty Payment 2% multiplied by the gross sales price of a Unit for the first 6 Units... Marketing Program Fee $625 per month for each project.
